items.reason: The claim that the contextual attributes are never consumed when request logging is disabled is false: downstream Graphite queries call logger.FromContext(ctx) at pkg/tsdb/graphite/graphite.go:93. That method consumes registered contextual attributes at pkg/infra/log/log.go:203-213 independently of PluginLogBackendRequests, so conditioning the contextual middleware on that flag would remove useful downstream logging context.
